captions.detailed: A clinical monocular microscope featuring a light gray cast base with a U-shaped front cutout, a vertical guide column, and an overhanging arm. Mounted on the arm is a black monocular eyepiece tube angled upwards, a rotating nosepiece turret with multiple objectives, and a black rectangular slide stage. It is equipped with independent coarse and fine focus knobs on the side of the main arm. The focusing carriage, stage, turret, and knobs are designed as separate components to allow for functional articulation.
captions.instruction: Generate a clinical monocular microscope with a cast base, vertical column guide, rectangular slide stage, and side-mounted coarse and fine focus knobs. Ensure the assembly includes separate, articulable parts: a vertically sliding focusing carriage, a rotating objective turret, a front-to-back sliding stage, and independently rotating focus knobs.
captions.factory: Construct the microscope using an ArticulatedObject builder. Model the base, column, and arm using a series of box primitives combined or transformed to form the structural frame. Use cylinder primitives for the eyepiece, objective turret, and the independent coarse and fine focus knobs. Define a prismatic joint for the vertical movement of the focusing carriage, a continuous rotational joint for the objective turret, a prismatic joint for the sliding stage, and continuous rotational joints for both focus knobs.
